title: Ball-Shaped Minimizers of Competing Nonlocal Energies
exact_target: Above a finite mass threshold, must every minimizer of this competing-interaction energy be a filled ball?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003221 (OWR-14751-005). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems and Effective Theories (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/43, pp. 2465--2511. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 40, 41, 42.
large-mass minimizers (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The parameter range $\alpha>0$ was recovered from PDF pages 40--42. The target concerns every minimizer for all masses beyond an exponent-dependent finite threshold, not only existence of one radial minimizer. The report\textquotesingle s diameter bound and asymptotic ball energy do not already prove eventual exact ball shape.
